rngRoute.encounter: Strike the barrels: break the rear barrel, then the two left barrels together.
rngRoute.setup: Replace the entry Unknown Room with Moment’s Reprieve; create the specified room adjacent. Save with the stated deck, return to title, reload, then roll only the stated number inside the save room. Enter the target encounter and activate the stocked sleights immediately.
rngRoute.caveat: Community route transcribed from DERIKUF; Steam players report success with the video methods, not a guaranteed per-route outcome. Retry from the save after failure.

guidance.title: Barrel encounters
guidance.text: Save while the barrels are intact. Leaving and re-entering a room does not restore broken barrels in Re:CoM; reload the earlier save or synthesize a fresh room. Defeat the Spider before it self-destructs, which gives no card prize.

records.successRule: Create a White Room. Complete three requested Fire, Blizzard or Thunder casts on a mushroom, or use Warp to remove it. Finish the encounter with White Mushroom as the last defeated enemy for its card roll. Darkness-room multipliers do not apply.
records.successVerification: Source-backed shared success rules and explicit remake room/rate rows; Warp mechanics explicitly preserve map/enemy-card prizes while excluding EXP. Not a guaranteed card drop.

repeatRoute.instructions: Create a save room next to the farming room and save before the attempt. Defeat the target last. If no card drops, return to the title screen and reload that save before retrying. Save successful drops before continuing.
repeatRoute.evidence: Steam players report this reload loop and successful use of DERIKUF’s RNG routes. Exact room layout, deck and dodge-roll sequence matter for a manipulation; success is not guaranteed on one attempt.
